label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group diagnostic cohort study with no randomized comparison or blinded treatment arm. The interventions are diagnostic tests and imaging procedures across cohorts, not placebo-controlled therapy, and the text describes follow-up assessments only. There is no evidence of any inactive comparator or sham placebo drug.
title: The Swedish BioFINDER 2 Study
